body:
Last weekend I enjoyed a tremendous time with Center for Action and Contemplation . If you’re unfamiliar with their work, I encourage you to look into it.

One of the highlights of my times with CAC is working with Fr. Richard Rohr, and being in a setting that brings “emerging Catholics” together with “emerging Protestants” and others. If you want to get a flavor for what’s emerging among Roman Catholic friends, check out, in addition to CAC,

 Cathlimergent

and

 Christian Nonduality

This weekend I’ll be in Chicago. Check my schedule page for details. On Monday I’ll be with the Episcopal Diocese there … details here.
